item: Weekly suite on the requirements.lock pins with one rolling issue
summary: The PR test jobs run on the newest release of every dependency (R318/R412), so the lock's pins were never run: five tests failed on SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 that were green on 2.1.x (row 113). A weekly workflow runs the three shards of ci.yml's test job with every package the lock names held to its pin through a name==version constraints file and keeps one lock-suite issue open while any shard is not green. Never on a PR. A local report run never touches issues or labels.
